verification: Official source audit only; not executed in Zed. Installed-release and transport verification required.
policy: Native subset with declared differences, not strict contract parity. Null bindings block unsupported operations. No Vim actions or simulated keystroke sequences.
scope: Single-document full editors with Vim/Helix disabled. Prompts, multibuffers, and modal editors retain their own bindings.

move.left.reason: Native MoveLeft crosses line boundaries and collapses existing selections; reference movement clamps at line start.

move.down.reason: Native MoveDown follows display rows, including soft wraps, not reference logical lines.

move.up.reason: Native MoveUp follows display rows, including soft wraps, not reference logical lines.

move.right.reason: Native MoveRight crosses line boundaries and collapses existing selections; reference movement clamps at line end.

move.word_previous.reason: MoveToPreviousWordStart uses Zed word boundaries; punctuation and language-specific rules need parity tests.

move.word_next.reason: Native MoveToNextWordEnd is not next-word-start; vim::NextWordStart depends on modal state.

move.line_start.reason: MoveToBeginningOfLine with stop_at_soft_wraps=false and stop_at_indent=false targets absolute logical line start.

move.line_end.reason: MoveToEndOfLine with stop_at_soft_wraps=false targets logical line end.

move.document_start.reason: MoveToBeginning targets document start in the guarded single-document context.

move.document_end.reason: MoveToEnd targets document end in the guarded single-document context.

move.paragraph_previous.reason: MoveToStartOfParagraph navigates a nonblank-line paragraph to its blank-line boundary or document start.

move.paragraph_next.reason: MoveToEndOfParagraph navigates a nonblank-line paragraph to its blank-line boundary or document end.

select.left.reason: Native SelectLeft extends across line boundaries; reference target clamps.

select.down.reason: Native SelectDown extends by display row rather than logical line.

select.up.reason: Native SelectUp extends by display row rather than logical line.

select.right.reason: Native SelectRight extends across line boundaries; reference target clamps.

select.word_previous.reason: SelectToPreviousWordStart uses the native movement target and persistent selection anchor.

select.word_next.reason: Native forward-word selection targets word end, not word start.

select.line_start.reason: SelectToBeginningOfLine disables soft-wrap and indentation stops.

select.document_start.reason: SelectToBeginning extends to the start of the single document.

select.document_end.reason: SelectToEnd extends to the end of the single document.

select.paragraph_previous.reason: SelectToStartOfParagraph uses the same native paragraph target as movement.

select.paragraph_next.reason: SelectToEndOfParagraph uses the same native paragraph target as movement.

edit.undo.reason: Undo uses native history units; grouping remains Zed-owned.

edit.redo.reason: Redo uses native history units and is not mapped as repeat-change.

edit.delete_word.reason: DeleteToNextWordEnd is not deletion to next-word-start; no safe exact native substitute audited.

edit.delete_3_words.reason: No audited atomic three-word-start deletion; simulated repeated keys would not guarantee semantics or history grouping.

edit.change_inside_parens.reason: Native SelectInsideDelimiters is an untyped selection, not atomic change inside parentheses. Typed Vim objects depend on modal operators.

edit.repeat.reason: vim::Repeat depends on Vim state; redo is a different operation.

search.open.reason: Deploys the native search bar. Confirm, Escape, and focus restoration use Zed's prompt bindings; adapter signals are scoped to the document.

search.next.reason: SelectNextMatch navigates the active search query from the document; the search bar retains native keys.

search.previous.reason: SelectPreviousMatch navigates the active search query from the document; the search bar retains native keys.

code.definition.reason: GoToDefinition uses the language service; availability and destination behavior depend on that service.

history.back.reason: pane::GoBack uses native navigation history, not undo history.

interaction.cancel.reason: editor::Cancel dismisses menus/diff/blame before collapsing selection. Multiple selections may require repeated cancellation; no guaranteed single-step collapse.

advanced.inside_around_delimiters: Native untyped SelectInsideDelimiters and SelectAroundDelimiters exist; repeated invocation expands outward. No typed-object parity claimed.
advanced.counts: Native fixed display-row counts exist; arbitrary operator/motion counts use Vim state.
advanced.registers: Vim PushRegister expects register input; not a native modeless register API.
advanced.macros: Vim ToggleRecord, PushReplayRegister and ReplayLastRecording depend on modal state.
advanced.extension_gap: Inspected public Extension trait does not expose arbitrary buffer edit callbacks or custom editor action registration.
advanced.remaining_categories: Full WORD/subword, character-find, marks, syntax objects, view navigation, clipboard policy, workspace and code-intelligence contracts remain deferred rather than assigned speculative bindings.
